products.label: M37 members within the tidal radius, CDS J/A+A/673/A114
products.process: Keep Hunt & Reffert's members of NGC_2099 inside the tidal radius that have a color; place each at the cluster's distance, spread in depth as widely as the members spread across the sky; color by Gaia BP-RP and tone by G magnitude.
limitations: A member's depth within the cluster is assumed (as deep as wide), not measured.
Gaia misses stars in the crowded core, and colors are not corrected for dust.
